name: App Prod-Parity E2E Dispatch

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    types: [labeled, synchronize, opened, reopened]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  dispatch:
    # main push + manual always run; PR events only when the label is present
    # and the PR comes from a branch in this repo (forks are excluded, since they
    # have no access to secrets or a writable token for the dispatch).
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'push' ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
       github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
       contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'run-e2e-apps-prod-parity-tests'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      statuses: write
    steps:
      - name: Resolve target SHA
        id: sha
        env:
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          EVENT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$PR_HEAD_SHA" ]; then
            echo "head_sha=$PR_HEAD_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "head_sha=$EVENT_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Post pending status
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ steps.sha.outputs.head_sha }}
        run: |
          gh api "repos/$REPO/statuses/$HEAD_SHA" \
            -f state=pending \
            -f context=app-prod-parity-e2e \
            -f description="Dispatching prod-parity e2e to twenty-factory"

      - name: Mint twenty-factory dispatch token
        id: app-token
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.TWENTY_WORKFLOW_DISPATCHER_CLIENT_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.TWENTY_WORKFLOW_DISPATCHER_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: twentyhq
          repositories: twenty-factory
          permission-actions: write

      - name: Dispatch to twenty-factory
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ steps.sha.outputs.head_sha }}
        run: |
          gh workflow run app-prod-parity-e2e.yaml \
            --repo twentyhq/twenty-factory \
            --ref main \
            -f head_sha="$HEAD_SHA"

      - name: Post dispatch-failed status
        if: failure()
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ steps.sha.outputs.head_sha }}
        run: |
          gh api "repos/$REPO/statuses/$HEAD_SHA" \
            -f state=failure \
            -f context=app-prod-parity-e2e \
            -f description="Failed to dispatch prod-parity e2e to twenty-factory"

name: CI Agent Skills Drift

# When a PR changes the app-development surface (twenty-sdk, create-twenty-app,
# twenty-client-sdk, or the shared manifest types), an agent checks whether the
# canonical skill content under packages/twenty-agent-skills is impacted and,
# only when it is, posts a single sticky comment with its findings.
#
# This is the skills counterpart to ci-app-docs-drift.yaml: the same source
# changes that stale the docs also stale the guidance agents follow.

on:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  changed-files-check:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/changed-files.yaml
    with:
      files: |
        packages/twenty-sdk/**
        packages/create-twenty-app/**
        packages/twenty-client-sdk/**
        packages/twenty-shared/src/application/**
        packages/twenty-shared/src/types/**

  agent-skills-drift-check:
    needs: changed-files-check
    # Secrets are unavailable on fork PRs; skip there and on bot PRs.
    if: >-
      needs.changed-files-check.outputs.any_changed == 'true' &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      github.event.pull_request.user.type != 'Bot'
    timeout-minutes: 30
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4.3.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Run agent skills drift agent
        id: drift-agent
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@ac7e24bf2938964b8ab203e417a2773802392ddd # v1.0.146
        with:
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
          claude_args: |
            --max-turns 60 --json-schema '{"type":"object","properties":{"hasDrift":{"type":"boolean"},"summary":{"type":"string"}},"required":["hasDrift","summary"]}' --allowedTools "Bash(git diff *),Bash(git log *),Bash(git show *),Bash(grep *),Bash(cat *),Bash(ls *),Bash(find *),Bash(head *),Bash(tail *),Bash(gh pr comment *)"
          prompt: |
            You are the agent-skills drift checker for the twenty repository.

            A pull request changed files in the app-development platform. Your job is to
            decide whether the skill guidance under `packages/twenty-agent-skills/`
            is impacted, and report your findings as ONE pull request comment.

            These skills tell coding agents how to build Twenty apps. When they go stale
            an agent confidently runs a command that no longer exists, so wrong guidance
            is worse here than a missing doc page.

            ## Canonical source only

            `packages/twenty-agent-skills/skills/` and
            `packages/twenty-agent-skills/references/` are the canonical content.

            `packages/twenty-agent-skills/dist/` is generated for distribution and is
            not committed to main. Report the canonical file that needs an edit.

            ## Step 1 — Understand the change

            The PR branch is checked out with full history; the base branch is
            `origin/${{ github.base_ref }}`. Inspect what the PR changes however you
            see fit. Only these kinds of changes are skill-relevant:

            - CLI commands, subcommands, flags, defaults, or help text
              (`packages/twenty-sdk/src/cli/commands/**`)
            - `define*` function signatures, config properties, validation rules,
              or their warnings (`packages/twenty-sdk/src/sdk/define/**`)
            - Enum / string-union values and manifest types
              (`packages/twenty-shared/src/application/**`, `packages/twenty-shared/src/types/**`)
            - Exports added/removed/renamed in the `exports` maps of `twenty-sdk` or
              `twenty-client-sdk` package.json, or in their public entry points
            - Front-component runtime hooks and host API
              (`packages/twenty-sdk/src/sdk/front-component/**`)
            - The scaffold template (`packages/create-twenty-app/src/constants/template/**`)
              and scaffolder flags/prompts (`packages/create-twenty-app/src/cli.ts`,
              `create-app.command.ts`)
            - Environment variables injected into logic functions or front components
            - Error codes surfaced to app developers
            - Default ports and instance URLs used during development

            Internal refactors, tests, and implementation-only changes are NOT relevant —
            if the changes contain only those, say so and stop.

            ## Step 2 — Map to skill content

            Use this mapping to know which files to check (read the actual files, all
            paths relative to `packages/twenty-agent-skills/`):

            | Source area | Skill content |
            |---|---|
            | CLI commands (`src/cli/commands`) | `references/manage-app/cli-and-sync.md`, `skills/manage-app/SKILL.md`, `references/concepts/operating-rules.md` |
            | Scaffolder flags, prompts, template | `skills/create-app/SKILL.md`, `references/develop-app/app-structure.md` |
            | `defineObject`/`defineField`/relations/indexes | `references/develop-app/data-model.md` |
            | `defineApplication`/roles/install hooks/variables | `references/concepts/how-apps-work.md`, `references/publish-app/prepare-for-app-store.md` |
            | Logic functions, triggers, connections, agents/skills | `references/develop-app/logic.md` |
            | Workflows and their lifecycle | `references/develop-app/workflows.md` |
            | Views, navigation, page layouts, command menu | `references/develop-app/layout.md`, `references/develop-app/standalone-pages.md` |
            | Front components, SDK imports, runtime hooks | `references/develop-app/front-components.md`, `references/design/front-component-ui.md` |
            | Test layout, test target ports | `references/develop-app/tests.md`, `references/concepts/operating-rules.md` |
            | Publish/install/deploy, versioning | `references/publish-app/prepare-for-app-store.md`, `skills/publish-app/SKILL.md` |
            | MCP endpoints, transport, auth | `references/use-twenty-mcp/setup.md`, `references/use-twenty-mcp/result-formatting.md` |
            | Enum value sets (FieldType, ViewType, availabilityType, NavigationMenuItemType, ...) | the reference documenting that value set (search for the enum name) |

            Two extra checks specific to this package:

            - `scripts/validators/` encodes cross-document contracts as literal string
              fragments (exact commands, ports, section headings). A renamed command or
              changed port can make a validator assert something no longer true, so check
              whether the change invalidates a fragment there.
            - `references/concepts/operating-rules.md` is the single source of truth for
              the durable rules and names exact commands. A command rename lands here.

            Also check whether the PR already updates the impacted files — if it does,
            verify the update matches the code change.

            ## Step 3 — Report

            If there is NO skill impact, do NOT post or create any comment.
            Skip the comment entirely and go straight to Step 4.

            Only when the skills are impacted, post exactly one comment on PR
            #${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} with:
            `gh pr comment ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --edit-last --create-if-none --body ...`
            (this updates the previous drift-check comment in place on subsequent runs).
            Start the comment body with the marker `<!-- agent-skills-drift-check -->`.

            Comment format:
            - Title line: `### Agent skills drift check`
            - A table with columns **Change** (what changed in the code),
              **Skill file** (repo-relative path, canonical only), **Status**
              (`✅ already updated in this PR` / `⚠️ needs update`), and **Suggested fix**
              (one concrete sentence, e.g. the exact command to replace).
            - When any row needs an update, end with one line reminding the author to run
              `npx nx run twenty-agent-skills:validate` after editing the canonical content.
            - Be terse. No preamble, no sign-off. Only report genuine drift — if unsure
              whether something is user-facing, say it's uncertain rather than asserting.

            ## Step 4 — Return the verdict

            After posting the comment, return your final answer as the structured
            output the CI gate consumes:
            - `hasDrift`: `true` if at least one impacted skill file still needs updating
              (drift is NOT fully resolved by this PR); `false` if there is no skill
              impact, or every impacted file is already correctly updated in this PR.
            - `summary`: one terse sentence describing the verdict.

            Environment: GH_TOKEN is available for `gh`. The PR branch is checked out.
          settings: |
            {
              "env": {
                "GH_TOKEN": "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
              }
            }

      - name: Gate on drift verdict
        if: always()
        env:
          AGENT_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.drift-agent.outcome }}
          STRUCTURED_OUTPUT: ${{ steps.drift-agent.outputs.structured_output }}
        run: |
          if [ "$AGENT_OUTCOME" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::Agent skills drift checker did not complete (agent step outcome: $AGENT_OUTCOME)."
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$STRUCTURED_OUTPUT" ]; then
            echo "::error::Agent skills drift checker did not return a structured verdict."
            exit 1
          fi
          has_drift=$(printf '%s' "$STRUCTURED_OUTPUT" | jq -r '.hasDrift')
          if [ "$has_drift" = "true" ]; then
            echo "::error::Agent skills drift detected. See the agent-skills-drift-check comment on this PR."
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$has_drift" = "false" ]; then
            echo "No agent skills drift."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::error::Structured verdict present but 'hasDrift' was not a recognizable boolean: $has_drift"
          exit 1

name: CI Agent Skills

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - package.json
      - packages/twenty-agent-skills/**
      - .github/workflows/ci-agent-skills.yaml

  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  changed-files-check:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/changed-files.yaml
    with:
      files: |
        package.json
        packages/twenty-agent-skills/**
        .github/workflows/ci-agent-skills.yaml

  agent-skills-validate:
    needs: changed-files-check
    if: needs.changed-files-check.outputs.any_changed == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Fetch local actions
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4.3.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 10

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/yarn-install

      - name: Agent Skills / Build and validate
        run: npx nx run twenty-agent-skills:validate

      - name: Agent Skills / Test
        run: npx nx run twenty-agent-skills:test

      - name: Agent Skills / List with the skills CLI
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          LISTING="$(npx -y skills@latest add ./packages/twenty-agent-skills/dist --list)"
          echo "$LISTING"

          for SKILL in create-app develop-app manage-app publish-app use-twenty-mcp; do
            grep -q "$SKILL" <<<"$LISTING" || {
              echo "::error::$SKILL missing from the collection listing"
              exit 1
            }
          done

          # The package path must scope discovery to the app skills; a listing that
          # also carries repository-wide skills means the source is wrong.
          if grep -q 'syncable-entity' <<<"$LISTING"; then
            echo "::error::listing leaked internal contributor skills"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Agent Skills / Install each skill independently
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for SKILL in create-app develop-app manage-app publish-app use-twenty-mcp; do
            INSTALL_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
            (
              cd "$INSTALL_DIR"
              npx -y skills@latest add "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/packages/twenty-agent-skills/dist" \
                --skill "$SKILL" --agent claude-code --agent codex --copy -y
            )
            npx nx run twenty-agent-skills:verify:install -- "$INSTALL_DIR" "$SKILL"
            rm -rf "$INSTALL_DIR"
          done

      - name: Agent Skills / Install the whole collection
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          INSTALL_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
          (
            cd "$INSTALL_DIR"
            npx -y skills@latest add "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/packages/twenty-agent-skills/dist" \
              --skill '*' --agent claude-code --agent codex --copy -y
          )
          npx nx run twenty-agent-skills:verify:install -- "$INSTALL_DIR"
          rm -rf "$INSTALL_DIR"

      - name: Archive the verified distribution
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: tar -C packages/twenty-agent-skills/dist -czf "$RUNNER_TEMP/twenty-agent-skills.tar.gz" .

      - name: Upload the verified distribution
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: twenty-agent-skills
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/twenty-agent-skills.tar.gz
          retention-days: 1
          if-no-files-found: error

  agent-skills-publish:
    needs: agent-skills-validate
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.repository == 'twentyhq/twenty'
    timeout-minutes: 5
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    outputs:
      released: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.released }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4.3.1

      - name: Download the verified distribution
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: twenty-agent-skills
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/agent-skills-artifact

      - name: Publish distribution branch
        id: publish
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch --depth=1 --no-tags origin main
          if [ "$(git rev-parse "$GITHUB_SHA:packages/twenty-agent-skills")" != "$(git rev-parse 'FETCH_HEAD:packages/twenty-agent-skills')" ]; then
            echo 'Skipping this distribution because the skills source has changed on main.'
            exit 0
          fi

          DISTRIBUTION_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/agent-skills-dist"
          PUBLISH_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/agent-skills-release"
          mkdir "$DISTRIBUTION_DIR"
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/agent-skills-artifact/twenty-agent-skills.tar.gz" -C "$DISTRIBUTION_DIR"

          REMOTE_BRANCH="$(git ls-remote --heads origin refs/heads/agent-skills)"
          if [ -n "$REMOTE_BRANCH" ]; then
            git fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/agent-skills
            git worktree add --detach "$PUBLISH_DIR" FETCH_HEAD
          else
            git worktree add --detach --no-checkout "$PUBLISH_DIR"
            git -C "$PUBLISH_DIR" switch --orphan agent-skills
          fi

          rsync -a --delete --exclude=/.git "$DISTRIBUTION_DIR/" "$PUBLISH_DIR/"
          cd "$PUBLISH_DIR"
          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo 'The agent-skills distribution is unchanged.'
            echo 'released=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi

          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git commit -m "Publish agent skills from $GITHUB_SHA"
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/agent-skills
          echo 'released=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  agent-skills-remote-source:
    needs: agent-skills-publish
    if: needs.agent-skills-publish.outputs.released == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4.3.1

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Download the verified distribution
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: twenty-agent-skills
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/agent-skills-artifact

      - name: Agent Skills / Install from the documented remote source
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p packages/twenty-agent-skills/dist
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/agent-skills-artifact/twenty-agent-skills.tar.gz" -C packages/twenty-agent-skills/dist
          INSTALL_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
          (
            cd "$INSTALL_DIR"
            npx -y skills@latest add 'https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/tree/agent-skills' \
              --skill '*' --agent claude-code --agent codex --copy -y
          )
          node packages/twenty-agent-skills/scripts/verify-install.js "$INSTALL_DIR"
          rm -rf "$INSTALL_DIR"

name: AI Catalog Sync

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * *' # Daily at 6 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch: # Allow manual trigger

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  sync-catalog:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    env:
      NODE_OPTIONS: '--max-old-space-size=4096'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4.3.1
        with:
          ref: main

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/yarn-install

      - name: Build dependencies
        run: npx nx build twenty-shared

      - name: Run catalog sync
        env:
          ARTIFICIAL_ANALYSIS_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ARTIFICIAL_ANALYSIS_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          npx nx run twenty-server:ts-node-no-deps-transpile-only -- \
            ./scripts/ai-catalog-sync/index.ts --report "${RUNNER_TEMP}/coverage.md"

      - name: Check for changes
        id: changes
        run: |
          catalog_dir=packages/twenty-server/src/engine/metadata-modules/ai/ai-models
          if git diff --quiet "$catalog_dir"; then
            echo "changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Compose pull request body
        if: steps.changes.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          cat > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/pr-body.md" <<'PREAMBLE'
          Automated daily sync of the AI model catalog.

          - Model identity, pricing, context windows and availability come from [models.dev](https://models.dev).
          - Intelligence, speed and cost per task come from [Artificial Analysis](https://artificialanalysis.ai/),
            which requires `ARTIFICIAL_ANALYSIS_API_KEY`.

          New models meeting inclusion criteria (tool calling, pricing data, context limits) are added
          automatically. Benchmark data is best-effort: a model Artificial Analysis has not rated keeps
          every other field and simply carries no `benchmark` entry.

          **Please review before merging** and check the coverage summary below for models that silently
          stopped matching.

          PREAMBLE
          cat "${RUNNER_TEMP}/coverage.md" >> "${RUNNER_TEMP}/pr-body.md"

      - name: Create pull request
        if: steps.changes.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@22a9089034f40e5a961c8808d113e2c98fb63676 # v7.0.6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: 'chore: sync AI model catalog'
          title: 'chore: sync AI model catalog'
          body-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/pr-body.md
          branch: chore/ai-catalog-sync
          base: main
          labels: ai, automated
          delete-branch: true

      - name: Mint twenty-infra dispatch token
        id: app-token
        if: steps.changes.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.TWENTY_WORKFLOW_DISPATCHER_CLIENT_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.TWENTY_WORKFLOW_DISPATCHER_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: twentyhq
          repositories: twenty-infra
          permission-actions: write

      - name: Trigger automerge
        if: steps.changes.outputs.changed == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
        run: |
          gh workflow run automerge-i18n.yaml --repo twentyhq/twenty-infra --ref main
